game_note: Oxygen is the single largest fraction of lunar soil by weight - extractable by heating (e.g. molten regolith electrolysis or hydrogen reduction of ilmenite).
Basis of lunar glass and silicon; also the main structural component of regolith.
Much richer in the bright highlands (anorthosite crust) - aluminium for construction.
Higher in the dark maria; magnetic ilmenite and native iron can be separated with magnets.
Reactive metal: could support electrolysis-based oxygen production.
Concentrated in maria like Tranquillitatis; ilmenite (FeTiO3) is the classic feedstock for oxygen extraction.
Iron-titanium oxide: heated with hydrogen it yields water, oxygen and iron - a workhorse ISRU mineral.
